about: Every country and the places (subdivisions or groups of them) Daily Atlas will cover. tier: easy = Americas and western Europe for a US English audience, hard = everything else. Weeks alternate easy and hard. Places come back later with NEW facts; check 'visits' and the game's earlier questions before writing a revisit.
